1.word_for_word: पञ्चचत्वारिंशकेऽथ पितृ-नन्दादि-सान्त्वनम् । — In the forty-fifth chapter, the consolation of the fathers, Nanda and others is given.; उग्रसेनाभिषेकश् च गुरौ वासात् पुरागमः ॥ — The coronation of Ugrasena and his stay with his spiritual master; उपलब्धार्थौ विदित्वा इति । — Knowing the two available meanings.; अयम् अर्थः---उप समीपे आवयोः पुत्र-बुद्ध्या सांसारिक-परम-सुख-भोगात् पूर्वम् एव लब्धार्थौ आवाम् ईश्वराव् इति लब्धः प्राप्तः परम-ज्ञान-रूपोऽर्थो याभ्यां, तौ तथा-भूतौ ज्ञात्वा मयि प्रसन्ने सत्य् अनयोर् ज्ञानं नाम किं दुर्लभं स्यात् ? — This means that the meaning in the form of supreme knowledge, which we have obtained before the enjoyment of the worldly supreme happiness by our son-intelligence near us, would be rare in the knowledge of these two, knowing them to be so and pleased with me?; दुर्लभं तु मयि पुत्रतया प्रेम । — But it is rare for me to love you as a son.; अत इदानीम् एव तज् ज्ञानं मा भूद् इति निजां स्वाधीनां मायां तयोः प्रसारितवान् इति ॥१॥ — Therefore, just now, He spread His own illusion of self-control to them, saying, "That knowledge may not be.
1.translation: In the forty-fifth chapter, the consolation of the fathers, Nanda and others is given. The coronation of Ugrasena and his stay with his spiritual master Knowing the two available meanings. This means that the meaning in the form of supreme knowledge, which we have obtained before the enjoyment of the worldly supreme happiness by our son-intelligence near us, would be rare in the knowledge of these two, knowing them to be so and pleased with me? But it is rare for me to love you as a son. Therefore, just now, He spread His own illusion of self-control to them, saying, "That knowledge may not be.

2.word_for_word: तद् एव दर्शयति उवाचेत्य् आदिभिर् अष्टभिः । — That is what he shows by the eight words, beginning with Uvāceti.; प्रीणन् प्रीणयन् सार्दरं ब्रुवन् ॥२॥ — Pleasing, pleasing, speaking with affection.
2.translation: That is what he shows by the eight words, beginning with Uvāceti. Pleasing, pleasing, speaking with affection.

3.word_for_word: अस्मत्तोऽस्मन्-निमित्तं नित्यम् उत्कण्ठितयोर् अपि युवयोः पुत्राभ्याम् आवाभ्यां कृत्वा बाल्य-पौगण्ड-कैशोरास् तत्-तद्-अवस्थानुभव-सुखानीत्य् अर्थः । — This means that you have made us, your sons and daughters, who are always anxious for us, to enjoy the pleasures of childhood, adolescence and adolescence in their respective states.; नाभवन्न् इति । — They didn’t happen.; अस्मत्तः पुत्राभ्याम् इति सामानाधिकरण्यं वा ॥३॥ — or from us and our sons, or to have equal authority.
3.translation: This means that you have made us, your sons and daughters, who are always anxious for us, to enjoy the pleasures of childhood, adolescence and adolescence in their respective states. They didn’t happen. or from us and our sons, or to have equal authority.

4.word_for_word: किं च, आवाम् एव दैव-हीनाव् इत्य् आह---न लब्ध इति । — Moreover, he argues that we are devoid of fate, and that we have not received it.; पितृ-गेह-स्था बाला यां मुदं विन्दन्ते, सा च न लब्धेति ॥४॥ — The happiness which children enjoy in their father's house is not attained.
4.translation: Moreover, he argues that we are devoid of fate, and that we have not received it. The happiness which children enjoy in their father's house is not attained.

5.word_for_word: एवं तावच् छ्लोक-द्वयेन युवयोर् आवयोश् च काम-हानिर् जातेत्य् उक्तम् । — Thus far, two verses have said that you and I have lost our desires.; आवयोः पुनर् युष्मत्-परिचर्या-लोपेन धर्म-हानिर् अपि जातेत्य् आह---सर्वार्थ-सम्भव इति । — Again, he argues that the loss of your service to us also causes the loss of religion, because it is possible for all purposes.; सर्वेषां धर्माद्य्-अर्थानां सम्भवो यस्मिन्, स देहो यतो याभ्यां जनितः पोषितश् च, तयोः पित्रोर् निर्वेशं निष्कृतिम् आनृण्यं मर्त्यं शत-संवत्सर-मात्रेण आयुषा न प्राप्नोति ॥५॥ — The body in which all religious and other wealth originates, from which it is born and nourished, does not attain the abode of the parents, the redemption of the debt, and the freedom from debt in a mere hundred years of life.
5.translation: Thus far, two verses have said that you and I have lost our desires. Again, he argues that the loss of your service to us also causes the loss of religion, because it is possible for all purposes. The body in which all religious and other wealth originates, from which it is born and nourished, does not attain the abode of the parents, the redemption of the debt, and the freedom from debt in a mere hundred years of life.

6.word_for_word: तन्-मध्ये पितुर् अपेक्षया यः पुत्रः कल्पः समर्थः सन्न् अपि [आत्मना] देहेन धनेन च पित्रोर् वृत्तिं जीविकां न संपादयेत्, तं प्रेत्य लोकान्तरे यम-दूताः स्वस्यैव मांसं खादयन्तीति ॥६॥ — In the midst of that, a son who, though capable of a kalpa, does not provide for his father with his body and wealth, even though he is capable of doing so, will be fed by the messengers of Yama in the next world after death.
6.translation: In the midst of that, a son who, though capable of a kalpa, does not provide for his father with his body and wealth, even though he is capable of doing so, will be fed by the messengers of Yama in the next world after death.

7.word_for_word: किं च, मात्रादि-शुश्रूषाम् अकुर्वन् विफल-जीवितश् च भवतीत्य् आह---मातरम् इति । — Moreover, he argues that one who does not take care of his mother and other things lives a fruitless life, saying, “My mother.”; अबिभ्रद् अपुष्णन् श्वसन्न् अपि मृत-तुल्य एवेति ॥७॥ — He is like a dead man, even if he does not carry, nourish or breathe.
7.translation: Moreover, he argues that one who does not take care of his mother and other things lives a fruitless life, saying, “My mother.” He is like a dead man, even if he does not carry, nourish or breathe.

8.word_for_word: तत् तस्मान् नौ आवयोः । — That’s why we’re both.; मोघं व्यर्थम् । — It’s futile and useless.; अनर्चतोर् अपूजयतोः ॥८॥ — They worship and do not worship.
8.translation: That’s why we’re both. It’s futile and useless. They worship and do not worship.

9.word_for_word: दुर्हृदा कंसेन कृत्वा ॥९.११॥ — The wicked Kaṁsa made him.

13.word_for_word: त्वम् एवाज्ञापयेति मा वदेत्य् आह---ययाति-शापाद् इति । — He said, “Do not say, 'You alone command,' because of the curse of Yayati.; तव तु यादवत्वेऽपि मदाज्ञया न दोष इति भावः ॥१३॥ — But even if you are a Yadava, there is nothing wrong with you by my command, this means.
13.translation: He said, “Do not say, 'You alone command,' because of the curse of Yayati. But even if you are a Yadava, there is nothing wrong with you by my command, this means.

14.word_for_word: मम तादृशी शक्तिर् नास्तीति चेत्, तत्राह---मयीति । — If I have no such power, then he says, I have.; मत्-प्रसादेन सर्वं भविष्यतीत्य् अर्थः ॥१४॥ — This means that by My grace everything will be possible.
14.translation: If I have no such power, then he says, I have. This means that by My grace everything will be possible.

15.word_for_word: स्वान् ज्ञातीन् सम्बन्धांश् च दिग्भ्य आनाय्येति ॥१५॥ — He brings his relatives and relations from all directions.
15.translation: He brings his relatives and relations from all directions.

17.word_for_word: सिद्धाः पूर्णाः । — They are perfect and complete.; कृष्ण-रामाभ्यां गतो निवृत्तो ज्वरस् तापो येषां ते ॥१७॥ — Those whose fever and suffering have been relieved by Krishna and Rama
17.translation: They are perfect and complete. Those whose fever and suffering have been relieved by Krishna and Rama

18.word_for_word: सदय-स्मितं वीक्षणं यस्मिंस् तत् ॥१८॥ — That in which he looks with a kind smile.
18.translation: That in which he looks with a kind smile.

19.word_for_word: प्रवयसो वृद्धा अप्य् अतिशयितं बलम् ओजश् च येषां, ते ॥१९॥ — Those who, even in old age, have exceedingly great strength and vigour.
19.translation: Those who, even in old age, have exceedingly great strength and vigour.

21.word_for_word: भृशम् आत्मनोऽप्य् आधिक्येन पोषितौ । — They were very much fed by their own abundance.; न चाश्चर्यम् एतद् इत्य् आह---पित्रोर् इति । — And this is not surprising, he argues, because of the fathers.; आत्मनो देहाद् अप्य् आत्मजेष्व् अभ्यधिका हि प्रीतिर् इति ॥२१॥ — For there is greater love for one's own children than for one's own body.
21.translation: They were very much fed by their own abundance. And this is not surprising, he argues, because of the fathers. For there is greater love for one's own children than for one's own body.

22.word_for_word: देवकी-वसुदेवयोः पुत्रौ युवां नास्मत्-पुत्राव् इत्य् अपि न वाच्यम् इत्य् आह---स पितेति ॥२२॥ — It is not to be said that you are the sons of Devakī and Vasudeva and not our sons, he replied, "He is my father.
22.translation: It is not to be said that you are the sons of Devakī and Vasudeva and not our sons, he replied, "He is my father.

24.word_for_word: स-व्रजं व्रज-वासिभिः सहितम् । — He went to Vraja with the inhabitants of Vraja.; कुप्यानि स्वर्ण-रजतादि-व्यतिरिक्त-कांस्य-पात्रादीनि तत् प्रभृतिभिः ॥२४॥ — The pots were made of gold, silver, etc., except for the bronze vessels, and so on.
24.translation: He went to Vraja with the inhabitants of Vraja. The pots were made of gold, silver, etc., except for the bronze vessels, and so on.

26.word_for_word: पुरोधसा गर्गाचार्येण द्विज-संस्कृतिम् उपनयनम् ॥२६॥ — The marriage ceremony of the brahmins by the priest Gargacharya.
26.translation: The marriage ceremony of the brahmins by the priest Gargacharya.

27.word_for_word: गावो गाः रुक्मय माला विद्यन्ते यासां ताः क्षौम-वस्त्र-मालावतीः ॥२७॥ — The cows are cows with golden garlands and they are dressed in silk clothes and garlands.
27.translation: The cows are cows with golden garlands and they are dressed in silk clothes and garlands.

28.word_for_word: याः पूर्वं मनो-दत्ता आसंस्ता एवाददात् । — He gave the same things that were previously given to him by the mind.; ननु ताः कंसेनापहृताः, सत्यम्, राज-गोष्ठाद् आच्छिद्य दत्ता इत्य् आह---कंसेनाधर्मत इति ॥२८॥ — It is true that they were abducted by Kaṁsa and cut off from the royal herd and given to them.
28.translation: He gave the same things that were previously given to him by the mind. It is true that they were abducted by Kaṁsa and cut off from the royal herd and given to them.

29.word_for_word: गायत्रं व्रतं ब्रह्मचर्यम् ॥२९॥ — Gayatri is the vow of celibacy.
29.translation: Gayatri is the vow of celibacy.

30-31.word_for_word: प्रकर्षेण भवन्त्य् आभ्याम् इति प्रभवौ अत एव सर्वज्ञौ स्वतः सिद्धम् अमलं ज्ञानं नर-चेष्टितैः प्रच्छादयन्तौ ॥३०.३१॥ — They are both originated by the attraction of both, and therefore they are omniscient and therefore cover up their self-perfect and immaculate knowledge by the actions of men.
30-31.translation: They are both originated by the attraction of both, and therefore they are omniscient and therefore cover up their self-perfect and immaculate knowledge by the actions of men.

32.word_for_word: यथा यथावत् । — As it is, as it is.; उपसाद्य प्राप्य गुरौ वृत्तिम् अन्यान् ग्राहयन्तौ शिक्षयन्तौ । — After approaching and receiving the teachers, they taught others the profession.; गुरुम् उपेताव् उपगतौ । — They approached the teacher and approached him.; सेवितवन्ताव् इत्य् अर्थः ॥३२॥ — They served, that is, they served.
32.translation: As it is, as it is. After approaching and receiving the teachers, they taught others the profession. They approached the teacher and approached him. They served, that is, they served.

33.word_for_word: शुद्धो भावो यासु ताभिर् अनुवृत्तिभिः । — By those instincts in which the pure feeling is attained.; साङ्गोपनिषदः अङ्गानि षड्-अङ्गानि शिक्षादीनि तैर् उपनिषद्भिश् च सहितान् । — The Sango Upanishads are the six parts of the Vedas, including the teachings and other Upanishads.
33.translation: By those instincts in which the pure feeling is attained. The Sango Upanishads are the six parts of the Vedas, including the teachings and other Upanishads.

34.word_for_word: स-रहस्यं मन्त्र-देवता-ज्ञान-सहितम् । — That mystery is accompanied by the knowledge of the mantras and the demigods.; धर्मान् मन्व्-आदि-धर्म-शास्त्राणि । — The religions, such as the Manus, are the scriptures of religion.; न्याय-पथान् मीमांसादीन् । — the paths of justice, mysticism, and so on.; आन्वीक्षिकीं तर्क-विद्याम् । — The intellectual science of logic.; षड्-विधां, "सन्धिश् च विग्रहो यानम् आसनं द्वैधम् आश्रयः" इत्य् एवं षड्-विधां राज-नीतिम् ॥३४॥ — The sixfold, "Treaty and conflict, the vehicle, the seat, the duality, the shelter," and thus the sixfold royal policy.
34.translation: That mystery is accompanied by the knowledge of the mantras and the demigods. The religions, such as the Manus, are the scriptures of religion. the paths of justice, mysticism, and so on. The intellectual science of logic. The sixfold, "Treaty and conflict, the vehicle, the seat, the duality, the shelter," and thus the sixfold royal policy.

35.word_for_word: सकृन् निगद-मात्रेणैक-वाराम् गुरोर् उच्चारण-मात्रेण ।तावतीश् चतुः-षष्ती-कलाः । — By chanting the mantra once, by chanting the mantra once, by chanting the mantra once, there are sixty-four arts.; 36.word_for_word: छन्दयामासतुर् उपलोभितवन्तौ ॥३६॥ — They chanted and seduced him.

37.word_for_word: प्रभासे क्षेत्रे महार्णवे मृतं बालं वरयाम् आस ॥३७॥ — In the field of Prabhas he found a dead child in the great ocean
37.translation: In the field of Prabhas he found a dead child in the great ocean

38.word_for_word: ईश्वराव् इति विदित्वा समुद्रस् तयोर् अर्हणम् आजहार ॥३८.३९॥ — Knowing that they were the gods the ocean offered them oblations
38.translation: Knowing that they were the gods the ocean offered them oblations

40.word_for_word: पञ्च-जनस् त्व् असुरोऽहार्षीत् । — The five-people were killed by the demon.; स च महान् ममासाध्य इत्य् अर्थः ॥४०.४३॥ — That is the great and unattainable means of Me.
40.translation: The five-people were killed by the demon. That is the great and unattainable means of Me.

41.word_for_word: सपर्यां पूजाम् । — Saparya poojaam.; सर्वेषां भूतानाम् आशया अन्तः-करणानि तान्य् आलयो निवासो यस्य तम् ॥४१॥ — The innermost actions of all beings are the abode of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
41.translation: Saparya poojaam. The innermost actions of all beings are the abode of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

45.word_for_word: निजं कर्मैव निवर्धनं यस्य तथा-भूतम् अपि मदाज्ञा-पुरस्कारेणानयतस् ते न दोष इत्य् अर्थः ॥४५.४६॥ — This means that it is not your fault that you have brought about the reward of My command even though it is your own action which is the only cause of your enhancement.
45.translation: This means that it is not your fault that you have brought about the reward of My command even though it is your own action which is the only cause of your enhancement.

47.word_for_word: वत्सेति प्राधान्येनैकस्य सम्बोधनम् । — Addressing one primarily as a calf.; गुरोर् निष्क्रयो गुरु-दक्षिणा । — The Guru’s inactivity is the Guru’s gift.; युष्मद् विधयोर् गुरोर् मम कामानां मध्वे को नु कामोऽवशिष्यते, न कोऽपीति ॥४७॥ — What desire remains in the midst of my desires for the spiritual master of your methods, and no one else?
47.translation: Addressing one primarily as a calf. The Guru’s inactivity is the Guru’s gift. What desire remains in the midst of my desires for the spiritual master of your methods, and no one else?

49.word_for_word: अनिल-वद्-रंहो वेगो यस्य तेन ॥४९॥ — The speed of which is like the wind.
49.translation: The speed of which is like the wind.

50.word_for_word: पर्जन्यो मेघस् तद्वन् निनदो यस्य तेन नष्टम् अदृष्टं तत् पुनर् लब्ध धनं याभिस् ता इवेति ॥५०॥ — The sound of the rain clouds is like the sound of a cloud which has lost what it has not seen and has regained it, just as those who have lost it have regained it.
50.translation: The sound of the rain clouds is like the sound of a cloud which has lost what it has not seen and has regained it, just as those who have lost it have regained it.
